findings.detail: The six maturity_not_past hits are source-disclosed current-period debt rows with maturities before 2025-12-31, not extraction-created dates.

rationale: The flag count is six, and the current-period SOI source itself lists exactly six debt investment rows with maturity dates before the 2025-12-31 report date: five One GI LLC rows dated 12/22/25 and one MPI Engineered Technologies, LLC row dated 11/17/25. Because the flagged maturity values are present in raw source and are not parser inventions or row misalignment, this is a false alarm for the extraction data; the rule is over-scoped for source-disclosed held positions with past maturity dates.
